svg.text: Give motion its own explicit signal

g.title: to control video you must control its motion not only appearance
g.desc: To control a video, you must control its motion, not only its appearance.
g.text: Control the motion, not just the appearance
A video is defined by how things move across frames.

g.title: insight motion vectors computed inside compressed video cheap explicit temporal dynamics
g.desc: Motion vectors, computed inside compressed video to encode inter-frame change, are a cheap, explicit description of temporal dynamics.

g.title: turning them into control signal lets users prescribe how things move
g.desc: Turning them into a control signal lets users prescribe how things move.

g.title: but mixing them sketches depth images hurts consistency motivating unified encoder space time
g.desc: But mixing them with sketches, depth, and images naively hurts consistency, motivating a unified encoder for space and time.
g.text: But mixing motion vectors with sketches, depth and images
→ motivates one unified encoder for space and time.
